<function=python>

# Player is at rows 45-47, cols 34-38. Small object at rows 41-43, cols 35-37.
# Try UP x1 to overlap with the small object.

result = action(['UP'])
print(f"Result: {result.get('board_changed')}, {result.get('gameplay_changed')}, done={result.get('done')}")

# Check if small object is still there
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
print("\n=== Nodes near small object ===")
for node in nodes:
    r_min = min(p[0] for p in node['boundary'])
    r_max = max(p[0] for p in node['boundary'])
    c_min = min(p[1] for p in node['boundary'])
    c_max = max(p[1] for p in node['boundary'])
    if 35 <= c_min <= 45 and 35 <= r_min <= 50:
        print(f"Node {node['id']}: color={node['color']}, pixels={node['pixels']}, rows {r_min}-{r_max}, cols {c_min}-{c_max}")

# Check player position
print("\n=== Player area ===")
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in range(40, 48):
    if r < len(ascii_lines):
        line = ascii_lines[r]
        print(f"Row {r}: {line[33:50]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
